entry.name: Generative AI Fundamentals in Python
entry.note: A short project-based path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Developers who want hands-on practice with LLM APIs

covers: Python basics: variables, data types, lists, loops, conditionals
Object-oriented programming, decorators, regular expressions, error handling
Command-line tools, virtual environments, Git, IDE setup
APIs and web scraping for AI applications
Prompt engineering and OpenAI Chat Completions API
Conversation history and token usage management
reading.format: Delivered through interactive lessons, hands-on exercises, and projects on the Dataquest platform, including guided interaction with Chandra and Jupyter Notebook projects.
reading.summary: This path teaches Python programming for generative AI, starting with basic Python and moving to interacting with large language models via API, prompt engineering, and building functional AI-powered applications. Completing the path earns a certificate that can be added to a resume or LinkedIn to showcase skills.
reading.audience: Anyone who wants to integrate AI capabilities into their work, including professionals aiming to add AI to their toolkit. The path starts at the most basic level, so beginners can understand the concepts.
